question: Who cuts the bond of the bound being through initiation and with what immediacy?
premises: The bond of the bound being is to be cut.
Initiation is the instrument of cutting.
The mantra-knower performs the act instantly.
inference: The mantra-knower should cut the bond of the bound being instantly through initiation.
plain_english: Thus the knower of mantra should cut the bond of the bound being by initiation in an instant.
